QuestInfo.name: Truth of the Rumor
QuestInfo.0: The archeologist, Doctor #p512#, currently does research at a camping site in #m10004051#. He recently called me about a strange rumor he heard.
QuestInfo.1: During the excavation, Doctor #p512# said he heard a rumor about a very old tree living in #m10004000#. However, he had no clue on what kind of tree it was, or where exactly it was located. That's why he's asked me to visit #b#m10004000##k village to collect information on this particular tree. Shall I start by visiting #b#p501##k?
QuestInfo.2: I met #p501# in #m10004000#. Would he know anything about that tree?

0.0: Have you heard the rumors? \r\n#b#L0# What rumors?#l
0.1: There are rumors about the Ghost Tree roaming around #m10004000#. \r\n#b#L0#A Ghost Tree? Could there really be a Ghost Tree? #l\n#L1#No way~ ghosts don't exist.#l
0.2: I guess so. I don't believe the rumors either. However, I've also heard of something else. There is a legend of a tree that has grown in #m10004000# since the olden days. You must have heard about it, right?\r\n#b#L0#Well... I don't recall...#l
0.3: Well, if the tree in question were actually real, then it'd help my research a lot. That said, I don't have enough evidence. Not many know about this particular tree. The tribespeople of #m10004000# seem to know something, but they won't answer my questions. \r\n#b#L0#Could they be hiding something?#l
0.4: This is why I need your help. I've heard you're closer to the #m10004000# tribespeople than I am. Would you please help and collect information about that tree?

yes.0: I see your curiosity got the better of you. In that case start your journey to #b#m10004000##k and find someone who knows about the tree. Yeah... why don't you go find #b#p501##k first?

no.0: Where has your thriving curiosity gone? If you thought it was bothersome, then why didn't you say so in the first place? What a waste of time.

1.0: Come now, a Ghost Tree? Such a thing can't possibly exist!
What's the matter?\r\n#b#L0#Have you heard about the Ghost Tree?#l
1.1: A ghost tree? Ah, you must be talking about the giant stump, right? I heard from my father that his father used to see such trees when he was young. The story says that each branch of the tree bears a red piece of cloth, which was dyed in the blood of ghosts. I have never seen it in person, so I don't know whether or not it's true.\r\n#b#L0#You didn't catch anything else?#l
1.2: I'm sorry, but I'm not really good at following rumors.

npc.0: Go to #b#m10004000##k and look for people who know about that tree. Yeah... why don't you go find #b#p501##k first?
